title: The sidebar never pins a red failure strip on a customer page, and stays silent when DSH's tab registry unloads under a re-sync
steps: S1: From the repo root run: node tests/regression/scripts/REG-PR-1038-sidebar-quiet-failures.mjs (the fork's vitest over tests/native-host-teardown.spec.ts and tests/no-diagnostic-strip.spec.ts: a real cordis fiber carrying the fork's real SidebarRightTabRegistry, unloaded, then a tab-policy reset that re-lists Files and a new tab type).
expect: S1 exits 0 with 5 passed and 0 failed.
After the host fiber unloads, neither the Files relist nor the new registration reaches reportFailure or console.error.
A live registry that refuses a duplicate id is still reported as 'register git'.
The client failure reporter only logs to the console; it never creates or appends a page element.

selectors.error: CordisError code INACTIVE_EFFECT ('cannot create effect on inactive context')

evidence: Desktop app (native profile), 08/10/2026 10:13 after a restart of dsh and the app: white window with the strip '[dsh-better-sidebar] native relist files error: cannot create effect on inactive context'.
fence: Mechanism only: the surface's handling of a registry whose fiber is gone, and the source of the failure reporter. Not covered: the live race (host unloading while Tracy's followTabPolicy disposer resets the policy) — not reproduced on a running native profile in 1 dsh restart + 13 HMR reloads.
